## Redfin (RDFN) — Acquired by Rocket Companies (RKT)

**Announced:** March 10, 2025 (merger agreement signed March 9, 2025) · **Closed:** July 1, 2025

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Price per share** | **$12.50 per RDFN share** (implied at announcement) |
| **Equity value** | **$1.75 billion** |
| **Enterprise value** | **~$2.4 billion** (~$2.36B), including assumption/refinancing of Redfin's debt (convertible notes + term loan) |
| Structure | 100% all-stock; fixed exchange ratio of **0.7926 RKT Class A shares** per RDFN share |
| Premium | 63% to Redfin's 30-day VWAP through March 7, 2025 |
| Ownership split | RKT holders ~95%, RDFN holders ~5% of combined company (fully diluted) |

**Important nuance — it was a fixed-ratio deal, not a fixed price.** $12.50 was just the mark-to-market at signing (RKT was trading around ~$15.77). Because the exchange ratio was fixed, the actual value moved with Rocket's stock:

- At closing, 130,446,226 Redfin shares × 0.7926 = **103,391,679 RKT shares issued at $14.18** (June 30, 2025 close) = **$1,466M** of stock, plus $24M of converted Redfin equity awards and $252M cash to settle Redfin's term loan → **total acquisition-date consideration of ~$1,742M** (per Rocket's accounting, ASC 805).
- That works out to roughly **$11.24 of Rocket stock per Redfin share** at close (0.7926 × $14.18) — i.e., Redfin holders ultimately received somewhat less than the headline $12.50, and Rocket's 10-K describes the transaction as "approximately $1,742" million in fair value of consideration transferred.

**Sources:** [Rocket press release, 3/10/25](https://ir.rocketcompanies.com/news-and-events/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Rocket-Companies-to-Acquire-Redfin-Accelerating-Purchase-Mortgage-Strategy/default.aspx) · [Redfin Form 425 FAQ, 3/26/25](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1382821/000162828025014827/redfin-425faqsround2.htm) · [Rocket Form 8-K, 7/1/25](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1805284/000110465925064824/tm2519538d1_8k.htm) · [Rocket FY2025 10-K purchase accounting](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1805284/000162828026013283/R9.htm)
judge_reason: All required deal figures are stated, but the added claim that Redfin holders received ~$11.24/share at closing contradicts the official $12.50 per share acquisition price.
